productOverview.headline: Triple-Camera Versatility for Visual & Geospatial Work
productOverview.description: The DJI Mavic 3 Pro pairs a Hasselblad main sensor with 70 mm and 166 mm tele lenses, delivering cinematic imaging alongside orthomosaic-capable photogrammetry for site documentation and pre-construction reconnaissance.

keyFeatures.headline: Key Features
keyFeatures.description: What sets the Mavic 3 Pro apart as a prosumer mapping tool.

items.title: Triple Camera Configuration
items.description: 4/3 CMOS Hasselblad main sensor plus 70 mm medium tele and 166 mm tele lenses.

items.title: High-Resolution Capture
items.description: Up to 5.1K video and 20 MP stills, ~12.8 stops dynamic range, 12-bit RAW support.

items.title: Omnidirectional Obstacle Sensing
items.description: Enhanced safety for flights near structures and vegetation.

items.title: Orthomosaic Generation
items.description: GSD ~2-4 cm at 100 m altitude, works best with high overlap (≥80/70) and GCPs.

cameraSystem.headline: Camera System (Key Strength)
cameraSystem.description: Cinematic-grade imaging in a compact prosumer body.
list: Resolution: Up to 5.1K video / 20 MP stills

flightPerformance.headline: Flight Performance
flightPerformance.description: Reliable range and safety systems for field work.

accuracyNotes.headline: Accuracy (Important Reality Check)
accuracyNotes.description: GCP-dependent accuracy given no built-in RTK.
